title: Piano teachers Camilla Todd and Massey DeVoyne; learning to read
summary: He studied with Camilla Todd, a church pianist who also played dance music, and with Miss Massey DeVoyne. He already played by ear and was taught to read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Now tell me about your teacher on piano.
Well, uh… A lady by name is Camilla Todd. How was that spelled?

And she used to play in the church at the First Street Baptist Church. That's the First Street Drive. Oh, that's the first town. Yeah. And I take lessons under her and I take lessons under another lady by name was Miss DeVoyne. Massey DeVoyne. I've heard her name. She used to live on Pusha Street. Mm-hmm.
Did either one of them ever play any dance music or just…

Oh, yeah. Camilla Todd played a lot of dance music years ago. Yeah, she used to play at the country club out there years ago. Yeah, she used to play the trumpet player by the name of Hippolyte Charles. Oh, yeah. He called him Hippolyte Charles. Exactly. On the way back, Joe Howard, fella called Joe Howard. I know him very well, yeah. He's dead now.
Yeah, she played the trumpet and the trubus.
That's right. Is that right? He played trumpet, yeah. Mm-hmm.
What did your teacher teach you? Did she teach you just regular classical music or dance music or what kind of a book did you use?
Well, she used the first grade of standard. The standard grade. Yeah, the standard grade. She taught you to read right away.
Yeah, she taught me to read.

That's right. Taught me to read. I just, I'd already knew how to play by ear, you know what I mean? I played by ear a long time. Piano? Yeah. What you did before that? I didn't know. You picked it up. Yeah, I picked it up, you see, on the piano. I played by ear a long time before I ever started the music.
Ever play any jobs by ear? Had you played by ear?
Yeah, sure. Before you took lessons? Before I took lessons, sure. Yeah.
